## Tolerance law

Source-solver/Monte Carlo uncertainty, binary storage error, LUT interpolation error, root-time tolerance, root-margin residual, limiting-magnitude envelopes, and deterministic event-time sensitivity are retained as separate receipts. Moira publishes no single aggregate tolerance or probabilistic confidence score for this model.
